∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (μ ν : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (w v : ℕ → ℝ),
  Summable w →
    Summable v →
      ∑' (i : ℕ), w i = 1 →
        (∀ (i : ℕ), Filter.Tendsto (μ i) Filter.atTop (nhds (w i))) →
          (∀ (i : ℕ), Filter.Tendsto (ν i) Filter.atTop (nhds (v i))) →
            (∀ (K : ℕ),
                ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, ν i N ≤ a N ∧
                    a N ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, ν i N + 1 - ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, μ i N) →
              Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds (∑' (i : ℕ), v i))
∀ (P : ℕ → Prop) (N : ℕ), ExternalO3CountablePartition.frequency P N = ↑(Finset.filter P (Finset.range N)).card / ↑N

∀ (P : ℕ → Prop) (N : ℕ),
  ExternalO3CountablePartition.frequency P N =
    ExternalO3CountablePartition.average (ExternalO3CountablePartition.bit P) N

∀ (P Q : ℕ → Prop) (d : ℝ),
  (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, P n ↔ Q n) →
    Filter.Tendsto (ExternalO3CountablePartition.frequency Q) Filter.atTop (nhds d) →
      Filter.Tendsto (ExternalO3CountablePartition.frequency P) Filter.atTop (nhds d)

∀ (label : ℕ → ℕ) (K n : ℕ),
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, ExternalO3CountablePartition.bit (fun m => label m = i) n = if label n < K then 1 else 0
∀ (bad : ℕ → Prop) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (i : ℕ), ExternalO3CountablePartition.selectedWeight bad w i = if bad i then w i else 0

∀ (label : ℕ → ℕ) (fails bad : ℕ → Prop) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (i : ℕ),
  Filter.Tendsto (ExternalO3CountablePartition.frequency fun n => label n = i) Filter.atTop (nhds (w i)) →
    (∃ M, ∀ (n : ℕ), M ≤ n → label n = i → (fails n ↔ bad i)) →
      Filter.Tendsto (ExternalO3CountablePartition.frequency fun n => label n = i ∧ fails n) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (ExternalO3CountablePartition.selectedWeight bad w i))

∀ (label : ℕ → ℕ) (fails : ℕ → Prop) (K n : ℕ),
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, ExternalO3CountablePartition.bit (fun m => label m = i ∧ fails m) n =
    ExternalO3CountablePartition.bit (fun m => label m < K ∧ fails m) n

∀ (u : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (K N : ℕ),
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, ExternalO3CountablePartition.average (u i) N =
    ExternalO3CountablePartition.average (fun n => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, u i n) N

∀ (x : ℕ) (x_1 : Fin (x + 1) → ℕ) (x_2 : Fin x → ℕ),
  ExternalO3GeneralBlockWords.blockWord x x_1 x_2 =
    match x, x_1, x_2 with
    | 0, x, x_3 => []
    | m.succ, lengths, exits =>
      List.replicate (lengths 0 - 1) 1 ++
        exits 0 :: ExternalO3GeneralBlockWords.blockWord m (fun i => lengths i.succ) fun i => exits i.succ

∀ (m : ℕ) (lengths : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ) (exits : Fin m → ℕ),

    ExternalO3GeneralDraft.refinedExponent m lengths exits

∀ (r ℓ κ : ℕ) (tail : List ℕ) (x : ℕ),
  ExternalO3Spec.IsOddSeed x →
    1 ≤ ℓ →
      2 ≤ κ →
        (ExternalO3GeneralStrideWords.StrideWordCell r (List.replicate (ℓ - 1) 1 ++ κ :: tail) x ↔
          ExternalO3Spec.blockLength x = ℓ ∧
            ExternalO3Spec.strideValuation (ExternalO3Spec.stride^[ℓ - 1] x) = κ ∧
              ExternalO3GeneralStrideWords.StrideWordCell r tail (ExternalO3Spec.nextBlock x))

∀ (ℓ κ x : ℕ),
  2 ≤ κ →
    ExternalO3Spec.strideValuation (ExternalO3Spec.stride^[ℓ - 1] x) = κ →
      ¬2 ≤ ExternalO3Spec.strideValuation (ExternalO3Spec.stride^[ℓ - 1] x) → False
∀ (ℓ κ x : ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ → ExternalO3Spec.blockLength x = ℓ → ∀ t < ℓ - 1, ¬t + 1 < ℓ → False

∀ (x ℓ : ℕ),
  1 ≤ ℓ →
    ExternalO3Spec.blockLength x = ℓ →
      ExternalO3Spec.stride (ExternalO3Spec.stride^[ℓ - 1] x) = ExternalO3Spec.nextBlock x

∀ (x i : ℕ),
  ExternalO3GeneralDraft.futureBlockSeed (ExternalO3Spec.nextBlock x) i =
    ExternalO3GeneralDraft.futureBlockSeed x (i + 1)

∀ (j r : ℕ) (tail : List ℕ) (x : ℕ),
  ExternalO3GeneralStrideWords.StrideWordCell r (List.replicate j 1 ++ tail) x ↔
    (∀ t < j, ExternalO3Spec.strideValuation (ExternalO3Spec.stride^[t] x) = 1) ∧
      ExternalO3GeneralStrideWords.StrideWordCell r tail (ExternalO3Spec.stride^[j] x)
∀ (j x t : ℕ), t + 1 < j + 1 → ¬t < j → False
∀ (j : ℕ), ¬0 < j + 1 → False
∀ (j t : ℕ), t < j → ¬t + 1 < j + 1 → False

∀ (m : ℕ) (lengths : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ) (exits : Fin m → ℕ),
  ExternalO3GeneralDraft.ValidBlockData m lengths exits →
    ∀ (x : ℕ),
      ExternalO3GeneralDraft.RefinedCell m lengths exits x ↔
        ExternalO3Spec.IsOddSeed x ∧
          ExternalO3GeneralStrideWords.StrideWordCell (lengths (Fin.last m))
            (ExternalO3GeneralBlockWords.blockWord m lengths exits) x

∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (n : ℕ),
  ExternalO3GeneralDraft.label h n =
    if 2 ≤ ExternalO3Spec.blockLength (2 * n + 1) then
      Sum.inl (ExternalO3GeneralDraft.ascendingOffsets h (ExternalO3GeneralDraft.window h (2 * n + 1)))
    else
      Sum.inr
        (ExternalO3Spec.strideValuation (2 * n + 1) - 2,
          ExternalO3GeneralDraft.positiveOffsets h
            (ExternalO3GeneralDraft.window h (ExternalO3Spec.stride (2 * n + 1))))

∀ (φ : ExternalO3Spec.Correction) (w : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Window ExternalO3GeneralDraft.depthOne),
  ExternalO3GeneralDraft.liftOne φ w = φ (w (ExternalO3GeneralDraft.zeroIndex ExternalO3GeneralDraft.depthOne))
∀ (P : ℕ → Prop) (N : ℕ), ExternalO3GeneralDraft.populationFrequency P N = ↑(Finset.filter P (Finset.range N)).card / ↑N

∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (w : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Window h) (i : Fin ↑h),
  ExternalO3GeneralDraft.positiveOffsets h w i = w i - 1

∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (b : Fin ↑h → ℕ) (i : Fin ↑h),
  ExternalO3GeneralDraft.positiveWindow h b i = b i + 1

∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (a : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.AscendingIndex h)
  (d : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.RefinedIndex ↑h),
  ExternalO3GeneralDraft.refinedFiberWeight h (Sum.inl a) d =
    (if (fun i => d.1 i.castSucc) = ExternalO3GeneralMarginal.ascendingCode h a then
        ExternalO3GeneralWeights.productWeight (↑h + 1) d.1
      else 0) *
      ExternalO3GeneralWeights.productWeight (↑h) d.2

∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (d : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.RefinedIndex ↑h)
  (a : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.AscendingIndex h),
  (ExternalO3GeneralDraft.refinementProjection h d = Sum.inl a) =
    ((fun i => d.1 i.castSucc) = ExternalO3GeneralMarginal.ascendingCode h a)

∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (a : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.AscendingIndex h),
  ∑' (d : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.RefinedIndex ↑h), ExternalO3GeneralDraft.refinedFiberWeight h (Sum.inl a) d =
    ExternalO3GeneralDraft.weight h (Sum.inl a)

            ExternalO3OptimizationCode.source p (ExternalO3OptimizationCode.edgeAt p q ((i + 1) % n)))

  ExternalO3OptimizationCode.tag p e = e / ExternalO3OptimizationCode.vertices p

  ExternalO3OptimizationCode.target p e =
    if ExternalO3OptimizationCode.tag p e = 0 then ExternalO3OptimizationCode.vertex p e - 1
    else ExternalO3OptimizationCode.vertex p e

  ExternalO3OptimizationCode.vertex p e = e % ExternalO3OptimizationCode.vertices p

∀ {V E : Type} (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (ψ : V → ℝ)
  (c : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.WalkData V E),
  ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.IsCycle g c →
    ∑ i, ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.edgeGain g ψ (c.edge i) = ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.cycleGain g c

∀ {V E : Type} (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (D : Finset E),
  ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.CycleSafe g D ↔ ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.HitsNonnegativeCycles g D

∀ {V E : Type} [inst : Fintype V] (c : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.WalkData V E),
  ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.IsElementary c → c.length ≤ Fintype.card V

∀ {V E : Type} (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (D : Finset E),
  ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.StrictFeasible g D → ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.CycleSafe g D

∀ {V E : Type} [inst : Fintype E] (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (ψ : V → ℝ),
  ExternalO3OptimizationDeletion.badEdges g ψ = {e | 0 ≤ ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.edgeGain g ψ e}

∀ {V E : Type} [inst : Fintype E] (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (ψ : V → ℝ),
  ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.CycleSafe g (ExternalO3OptimizationDeletion.badEdges g ψ)

∀ {V E : Type} (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (D : Finset E),
  (∀ (e : E), 0 ≤ g.weight e) → 0 ≤ ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.deletionCost g D

∀ {V E : Type} [Fintype E] (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E),
  ∃ D,
    ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.CycleSafe g D ∧
      ∀ (A : Finset E),
        ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.CycleSafe g A →
          ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.deletionCost g D ≤ ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.deletionCost g A

∀ {V E : Type} [inst : Fintype E] (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (ψ : V → ℝ),
  ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.failureCost g ψ =
    ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.deletionCost g (ExternalO3OptimizationDeletion.badEdges g ψ)

∀ {V E : Type} [inst : Fintype E] (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (ψ : V → ℝ),
  (∀ (e : E), 0 ≤ g.weight e) → 0 ≤ ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.failureCost g ψ

∀ {V E : Type} [inst : Fintype E] (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (D : Finset E) (ψ : V → ℝ),
  (∀ e ∉ D, ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.edgeGain g ψ e < 0) → ExternalO3OptimizationDeletion.badEdges g ψ ⊆ D

∀ {V E : Type} [inst : Fintype E] (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (D : Finset E) (ψ : V → ℝ),
  (∀ (e : E), 0 ≤ g.weight e) →
    (∀ e ∉ D, ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.edgeGain g ψ e < 0) →
      ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.failureCost g ψ ≤ ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.deletionCost g D

∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (M J : ℕ),
  2 ≤ M →
    2 ≤ J →
      ↑(ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.finiteOptimum h M J) =
        ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.deletionInfimum (ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.truncatedGraph h M J)

∀ {V E : Type} (length : ℕ) (vertex : Fin (length + 1) → V) (edge : Fin length → E) (length_1 : ℕ)
  (vertex_1 : Fin (length_1 + 1) → V) (edge_1 : Fin length_1 → E),
  ({ length := length, vertex := vertex, edge := edge } = { length := length_1, vertex := vertex_1, edge := edge_1 }) =
    (length = length_1 ∧ vertex ≍ vertex_1 ∧ edge ≍ edge_1)

∀ {V E : Type} [inst : SizeOf V] [inst_1 : SizeOf E] (length : ℕ) (vertex : Fin (length + 1) → V)
  (edge : Fin length → E), sizeOf { length := length, vertex := vertex, edge := edge } = 1 + sizeOf length
∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (M : ℕ) (v : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.Vertex h M) (i : Fin ↑h), ↑(v i) - 1 < M

∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (M : ℕ) (v : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.Vertex h M) (i : Fin ↑h),
  ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.ascTarget h M v i = if ↑i = 0 then ⟨↑(v i) - 1, ⋯⟩ else v i
∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (M J : ℕ), ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.commonExponent h M J = J + ↑h * M

∀ {V E : Type} (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (c : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.WalkData V E),
  ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.cycleGain g c = ∑ i, g.baseGain (c.edge i)

∀ (h : ExternalO3GeneralDraft.Depth) (M : ℕ) (v : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.Vertex h M) (i : Fin ↑h),
  ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.decodeVertex h M v i = ↑(v i) + 1

∀ {V E : Type} (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (D : Finset E),
  ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.deletionCost g D = ∑ e ∈ D, g.weight e

∀ {V E : Type} (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (ψ : V → ℝ) (e : E),
  ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.edgeGain g ψ e = g.baseGain e + ψ (g.target e) - ψ (g.source e)

∀ {V E : Type} (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (D : Finset E) (x : V) (e : E) (l : List E),
  ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.KeptPath g D x (e :: l) =

  ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.KeptPath g D x x_1 =
    match x, x_1 with
    | x, [] => True
    | u, e :: l => g.source e = u ∧ e ∉ D ∧ ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.KeptPath g D (g.target e) l

∀ {V E : Type} (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (D : Finset E)
  (c : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.WalkData V E),
  ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.IsCycle g c →
    (∀ (i : Fin c.length), c.edge i ∉ D) →
      ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.KeptPath g D (c.vertex 0) (List.ofFn c.edge) ∧
        ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathEnd g (c.vertex 0) (List.ofFn c.edge) = c.vertex 0 ∧
          ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathGain g (List.ofFn c.edge) = ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.cycleGain g c

∀ {V E : Type} [Fintype E] (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (D : Finset E),
  ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.CycleSafe g D → ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.StrictFeasible g D

∀ {V E : Type} (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (D : Finset E),
  (∀ (c : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.WalkData V E),
      ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.IsCycle g c →
        ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.IsElementary c →
          (∀ (i : Fin c.length), c.edge i ∉ D) → ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.cycleGain g c < 0) →
    ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.CycleSafe g D
∀ {V E : Type} (c : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.WalkData V E), c.length = 0 → 0 < c.length → False

∀ {V E : Type} [Fintype E] (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (D : Finset E) (u : V),
  ∃ p,
    ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.KeptPath g D u p ∧
      (ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathVertices g u p).Nodup ∧
        ∀ (q : List E),
          ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.KeptPath g D u q →
            (ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathVertices g u q).Nodup →
              ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathGain g q ≤ ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathGain g p

∀ {E : Type} (s : Finset E) (x y : E → ℝ),
  (∀ e ∈ s, x e < 0 ∨ x e = 0 ∧ y e < 0) → ∃ δ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ e ∈ s, ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε ≤ δ → x e + ε * y e < 0
ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.GenericElementaryReduction
ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.GenericStrictCycleCriterion

∀ {V E : Type} (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (D : Finset E) (u : V) (l m : List E),
  ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.KeptPath g D u (l ++ m) ↔
    ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.KeptPath g D u l ∧
      ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.KeptPath g D (ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathEnd g u l) m
∀ {a b c : Prop}, ((a ∧ b) ∧ c) = (a ∧ b ∧ c)

∀ {V E : Type} (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (D : Finset E) (u : V) (l : List E),
  ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.KeptPath g D u l → ∀ (i : Fin l.length), l.get i ∉ D

∀ {V E : Type} (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (D : Finset E) (u : V) (l : List E),
  (∀ (i : Fin l.length), g.source (l.get i) = ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathVertex g u l ↑i) →
    (∀ (i : Fin l.length), l.get i ∉ D) → ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.KeptPath g D u l

∀ {V E : Type} (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (D : Finset E) (u : V) (l : List E),
  ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.KeptPath g D u l →
    l ≠ [] →
      ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathEnd g u l = u →
        ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.IsCycle g (ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.listWalk g u l)

∀ {V E : Type} (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (u : V) (l : List E),
  ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.cycleGain g (ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.listWalk g u l) =
    ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathGain g l

∀ {V E : Type} [inst : Fintype E] (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (D : Finset E),
  ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.CycleSafe g D →
    ∀ e ∉ D, ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.edgeGain g (ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathPotential g D) e ≤ 0

∀ {V E : Type} (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (c : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.WalkData V E),
  ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.IsCycle g c →
    ∀ (i : Fin (c.length + 1)), ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathVertex g (c.vertex 0) (List.ofFn c.edge) ↑i = c.vertex i
∀ {V E : Type} (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (x : V), ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathEnd g x [] = x

∀ {V E : Type} (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (x : V) (e : E) (l : List E),
  ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathEnd g x (e :: l) = ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathEnd g (g.target e) l

∀ {V E : Type} (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (x : V) (x_1 : List E),
  ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathEnd g x x_1 =
    match x, x_1 with
    | u, [] => u
    | x, e :: l => ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathEnd g (g.target e) l

∀ {V E : Type} (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (u : V) (l m : List E),
  ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathEnd g u (l ++ m) =
    ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathEnd g (ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathEnd g u l) m

∀ {V E : Type} (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (l : List E),
  ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathGain g l = (List.map g.baseGain l).sum

∀ {V E : Type} (g : ExternalO3OptimizationDraft.FiniteGraph V E) (l m : List E),
  ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathGain g (l ++ m) =
    ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathGain g l + ExternalO3OptimizationPaths.pathGain g m

∀ {ι : Type u_1} (a : ℕ → ℝ) (μ ν : ι → ℕ → ℝ) (w v : ι → ℝ),
  Summable w →
    Summable v →
      ∑' (i : ι), w i = 1 →
        (∀ (i : ι), Filter.Tendsto (μ i) Filter.atTop (nhds (w i))) →
          (∀ (i : ι), Filter.Tendsto (ν i) Filter.atTop (nhds (v i))) →
            (∀ (s : Finset ι),
                ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∑ i ∈ s, ν i N ≤ a N ∧ a N ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ν i N + 1 - ∑ i ∈ s, μ i N) →
              Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds (∑' (i : ι), v i))

∀ {ι : Type u_1} (label : ℕ → ι) (s : Finset ι) (n : ℕ),
  ∑ i ∈ s, ExternalO3CountablePartition.bit (fun m => label m = i) n =
    ExternalO3CountablePartition.bit (fun m => label m ∈ s) n

∀ {ι : Type u_1} (bad : ι → Prop) (w : ι → ℝ) (i : ι),
  ExternalO3PartitionGeneral.selectedWeight bad w i = if bad i then w i else 0

∀ {ι : Type u_1} (label : ℕ → ι) (fails : ℕ → Prop) (bad : ι → Prop) (w : ι → ℝ) (i : ι),
  Filter.Tendsto (ExternalO3CountablePartition.frequency fun n => label n = i) Filter.atTop (nhds (w i)) →
    (∃ M, ∀ (n : ℕ), M ≤ n → label n = i → (fails n ↔ bad i)) →
      Filter.Tendsto (ExternalO3CountablePartition.frequency fun n => label n = i ∧ fails n) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (ExternalO3PartitionGeneral.selectedWeight bad w i))

∀ {ι : Type u_1} (label : ℕ → ι) (fails : ℕ → Prop) (s : Finset ι) (n : ℕ),
  ∑ i ∈ s, ExternalO3CountablePartition.bit (fun m => label m = i ∧ fails m) n =
    ExternalO3CountablePartition.bit (fun m => label m ∈ s ∧ fails m) n

∀ {ι : Type u_1} (u : ι → ℕ → ℝ) (s : Finset ι) (N : ℕ),
  ∑ i ∈ s, ExternalO3CountablePartition.average (u i) N =
    ExternalO3CountablePartition.average (fun n => ∑ i ∈ s, u i n) N
